name: antigravity-remote
description: Controle remoto web/PWA para Google Antigravity (Next.js + Neon Postgres + Better Auth + Daemon local)

scripts.build: npm --workspace=@antigravity-remote/protocol run build && npm --workspace=@antigravity-remote/daemon run build && npm --workspace=@antigravity-remote/web run build
scripts.build:web: npm --workspace=@antigravity-remote/protocol run build && npm --workspace=@antigravity-remote/web run build
scripts.build:daemon: npm --workspace=@antigravity-remote/protocol run build && npm --workspace=@antigravity-remote/daemon run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace=@antigravity-remote/protocol run typecheck && npm --workspace=@antigravity-remote/daemon run typecheck && npm --workspace=@antigravity-remote/web run typecheck
